confirmed_findings.claim: CheckPolicy reads the untrusted working-tree policy's mode when the base fails to resolve, so an agent in a gated/strict target repo can bypass the entire ACDSL self-management gate by writing acdsl/policy.json as {"mode":"free","base_ref":"nosuchref"}, making acdsl check return zero diagnostics despite the committed base policy being authoritative.
confirmed_findings.fix: In CheckPolicy's baseErr branch, decide free-vs-hard-error from a value the edit under test cannot forge: either attempt basePolicy via resolvable fallback paths (treating only the no-base-and-no-committed-policy case as free), or hard-error whenever base_ref is explicitly set in the working policy but fails to resolve, falling back to free only when base_ref is unset and no default candidates exist; add a test combining attacker-set mode "free" with an unresolvable base_ref against a committed gated base, expecting a hard error.

confirmed_findings.claim: The new 85-line skill-invoke-gate.sh PreToolUse hook, which can deny any tool call session-wide, is shipped, tested, and registered in settings.json without any governing plan entry in plans/v1-2-1/, violating the repo doctrine that new guard/validation logic needs an approved plan example, and its Bash detection only catches the exact two-word 'cat <path>' shape.
confirmed_findings.fix: Confirm with the implementer whether it was scoped under a plan not included in plans/v1-2-1/, or file the missing plan/Changes entry retroactively so the design intent (which sessions it applies to, what it catches vs. not) is recorded somewhere other than the hook's own comments.

confirmed_findings.claim: The peek-port stale-kill loop passes lsof's potentially multi-line PID output as a single non-numeric argument to kill, which is silently swallowed by || true, leaving the stale peek process running and the fresh-respawn guarantee unmet with no operator signal.
confirmed_findings.fix: Iterate over the PIDs (for p in $pid; do kill "$p"; done) or use xargs kill, drop the || true swallow, or echo-log when the previous listener is still up after the wait.

confirmed_findings.claim: cp of the skill-overrides overlay unconditionally overwrites .claude/settings.local.json in the main checkout with no backup whenever the overlay file exists, silently destroying a developer's hand-edited local settings on the next bootstrap run.
confirmed_findings.fix: Back up an existing file before overwrite, or merge the skill-overlay keys into the existing JSON instead of a blind cp.

confirmed_findings.claim: startPeek/peekIdentity added a backLink parameter and --back-link peek argument not present in the peek-multiple-profiles plan's pseudocode, a silent signature deviation from a plan that is supposed to be a binding contract.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add a one-line Changelog entry on the peek-multiple-profiles plan recording the backLink addition.
